originalText.text:
I recently ate here and the experience was nothing short of delightful. The warm ambiance and rustic decor created a welcoming atmosphere. The staff was friendly and attentive, providing excellent service throughout the meal.

Now, let’s talk about the star of the show—the Spanish chicken. The menu boasted a variety of flavorful dishes, each showcasing the chef’s expertise in combining traditional Spanish flavors with a modern twist. The chicken was perfectly cooked, tender on the inside with a crispy, golden exterior that left my taste buds dancing.

The appetizers were equally impressive, with options ranging from patatas bravas to chorizo croquettes. Each bite was a burst of Spanish authenticity. The chef’s commitment to using high-quality ingredients was evident, enhancing the overall dining experience.

The drink menu featured a well-curated selection of Spanish wines and cocktails that complemented the meal superbly. The sangria, in particular, was a refreshing choice that added to the festive atmosphere of the restaurant.

What truly stood out was the attention to detail in presentation. Each dish was a work of art on the plate, showcasing the chef’s dedication to not only taste but also aesthetics.

As for the dessert, the churros were a delightful way to end the meal. Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and accompanied by rich chocolate dipping sauce—a sweet ending to a savory journey.

In summary, this Spanish chicken restaurant exceeded my expectations. From the inviting ambiance to the delectable dishes, every aspect of the dining experience was carefully crafted. I highly recommend this establishment to anyone seeking an authentic taste of Spain with a modern flair. ¡Delicioso!

originalText.text:
Black consumer beware! I know ppl have been going to this restaurant for as long as it’s been around, but the community really needs to reconsider. I went in after not going for some time, (literally more than a year+ - and only by invitation by my mother) and I was reminded why I NEVER GO IN HERE. I asked for the chicken with rice and beans. This used to just be a simple lunch special type order. You would have thought I asked for mountains to be moved and for heaven to be brought down to earth. The server, one who apparently spoke no English, I guess put the wrong type of rice because when I said I want beans, she got the nastiest attitude and asked if I wanted a side order of beans. I said no. I just want the beans that come with my meal. Chicken. Rice. Beans. I didn’t understand the problem. But then, it became clear. She was supposed to add the white rice. And becasue she didn’t, she was not going to give me beans. Like, what?!? She proceeds to speak in Spanish and speak to another server there to very obviously complain and curse me out. The other server was actually apologetic to me, but clearly couldn’t control the first one. I wasn’t even upset until the first server continued to act like I was  inconveniencing her because she needed to change the rice. Lady, just put the beans on the rice! There were literally two Spanish people that ordered before me and one - a Puerto Rican friend of mine from the neighborhood ORDERED THE SAME THING, and there was no issue. No rudeness. When she was serving me, everything changed. I absolutely should have walked out as she carried on too afraid to speak English or just not able to.  I did not walk out because I had already come from across the street where the food looked a bit dry. I just wanted to have a a quick delicious Spanish style lunch. While the one server was nice enough, I just said this is the second time at this location that I have been treated like this and I think it’s because I am black and I don’t speak Spanish. My mother always goes there, but she absolutely looks Puerto Rican so she never has an issue, but I am BLACK! Very BLACK! I will NEVER PATRONIZE THIS PLACE AGAIN. MY (OUR) PRESENCE AND MONEY IS NOT VALUED! I was standing at the counter paying for my food and the server was STILL being horrible. For the life of me, I can’t understand why black folks continuously patronize businesses by other cultures that would NEVER patronize theirs. I NEVER SEE ASIAN OR HISPANIC OR INDIAN PPL IN ANY BLACK OR AFRICAN BUSINESS. I’ve been very good about avoiding certain businesses and I cook a lot at home. But every now and again I just want to dip my toe back out to test the waters. I get bitten every time. Lesson Learned. PS. The food was NOT EVEN GOOD. And I’m not saying that to be petty. It was NOT GOOD. SMH. Chicken dry, beans bland. I had to add my own Goya beans when I got home.

Edit: Do yourself a favor and read through the lowest ratings. I read after posting and ppl have been experiencing this and other terrible things for years. Nothing has changed. And then do yourself another favor and avoid if you are black (unless you speak Spanish).

Hidden gem. Roseli is high quality Cantonese, as good as any in Flushing or Chinatown or Sunset Park.

The food is spectacular. Their pork dishes, fish dishes, veggies, tofu, and noodle dishes were all amazing. Perfect amount of flavor, without being heavy or greasy. The crispy noodles were executed with precision. The fried fish was so tender and crazy. The saucy pork chops explodes with savory flavor.

The service is top notch. Billy is attentive and cares so much about the food and experience. We feel blessed to find places like this in the neighborhood.

Can’t wait to come back for dim sum and watch a game at the bar!

originalText.text:
It is extremely unusual to have a authentic Chinese restaurant in the Marriott hotel in North America

The staff is extremely friendly and I was able to speak with the chef who is from TaiShan Guangdong about his experience as dim sum chef also his uncle who used to have the most famous restaurant in China Town Manhattan…

Therefore we came back to the hotel a bit earlier one night of our five nights stay specially to try what the chef recommended..

Lobster with sticky rice: very tasty and this is excellent dish … priced USD 53? it doesn’t sound very expensive but it comes with a very small lobster… sad

Steamed spareribs is very good and they have us a bowl of steamed rice too…

Veggie- as our request how to make it …

It was very rush late dinner! Since we ate something before that, thus why we didn’t order a lot … the whole purpose is to try the Lobster 🦞 with sticky rice 🍚

👍👍👍
